headline: BUA Foods Expands Gross Margin to 48.3% as Profit Rises
summary: Nigerian food manufacturer BUA Foods Plc reported an increase in gross profit to ₦552.90 billion and a profit after tax of ₦450 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, with the gross margin expanding to 48.3%.
why: BUA Foods is a major consumer goods producer in Nigeria, providing insights into consumer demand, inflationary cost management, and the profitability of West African manufacturing firms.

impacts.name: BUA Foods Plc
impacts.why: Improved cost efficiency and disciplined operations drove higher profit margins.
